headline: Last session: Markets extended four-week rally to hit nine-month highs driven by record FII buying

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying supported Indian equities, pushing Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs.
Bounces in auto and banking stocks helped indices recover from earlier drops.
Global sell-off in AI stocks and Fed rate hike signals created periodic drag on market sentiment.
Surge in crude oil prices driven by US-Iran tensions added cost pressures.
whatHappening: Indian stock market extended its 4-week rally despite global headwinds.
Maruti Suzuki announced price hikes on select vehicle models due to cost pressures.
Mahindra Last Mile Mobility announced plans to launch an IPO within 18 months.
Gold prices faced a dramatic selloff, touching the lowest level of 2026.
summary:
Indian equities extended their four-week rally to hit nine-month highs, propelled by strong FII buying and recoveries in banking and auto sectors.
Global AI stock selloffs, crude oil spikes, and Fed interest rate concerns posed headwinds during recent trading sessions.
Maruti Suzuki announced model price hikes while Mahindra's EV arm eyes an IPO within 18 months.
